name: io.github.razvangirgiz/wazap
description: WhatsApp for your agent: chats, messages, media, contacts and groups behind MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: WAZAP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Refuse every write. The write tools are not registered at all.

environmentVariables.name: WAZAP_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where wazap keeps credentials, history and media. Defaults to ~/.wazap.
